mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid(bid_date, bid_company, legal_person, phone, tender_id, batch_number, production_date, expiration_date, total_amount, deposit_date, status) VALUES(#{bidDate}, #{bidCompany}, #{legalPerson}, #{phone}, #{tenderId}, #{batchNumber}, #{productionDate}, #{expirationDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{depositDate}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bid ORDER BY bid_date DESC
